gold: Hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole

selector.rationale: Multimodal imaging and en face imaging with swept source optical coherence tomography demonstrated a lamellar macular hole with hyperoleon and oil bubbles within its boundaries, strongly supporting this diagnosis

rejected.label: Rhegmatogenous Retinal Detachment
rejected.why: Although the patient had a history of rhegmatogenous retinal detachment, the current findings do not support an active detachment

rejected.label: Silicone oil-induced retinal toxicity
rejected.why: While silicone oil is present, the primary issue appears to be the lamellar macular hole rather than toxicity

rejected.label: Silicone oil syndrome
rejected.why: The score for this condition is low and the primary findings support a lamellar macular hole
